title: register-connector: volume alerting, rate limit, and correlation of refused re-key attempts
description:
## BLUF

`register-connector` is the highest-blast-radius admin operation on the platform and has **no volume alerting and no rate limit**. Bulk re-key ([KS-576](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-576)) makes it cheaper to trigger, which raises the cost of leaving it unmonitored.

Carried over from @peter's own candidate list on KS-480, unchanged.

## Detail

The route (`services/api-gateway/src/routes/platform.ts:476`) refuses connector-authorised rotates (`:499-509`) but nothing observes the pattern of use:

* no alert on an unusual **volume** of rotations in a window
* no rate limit on the route itself
* refused re-key attempts are not correlated — a series of 403s from a connector credential probing the rotate path looks like nothing

### Added 2026-09-14 — register #15 from [KS-533](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-533/sk-security-register-data-loss-unrecoverability-scenarios-code) (`externalRef` collision / wrong environment)

Carried here on closing [KS-533](<https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-533>) (register row #15, Low likelihood, ⚠️ manual merge to recover). Same route, same blast radius, so it belongs with the rate-limit/alerting work rather than on its own ticket.

**Scenario:** a reused or typo'd OrganisationGuid, or a staging S registering against prod K. Duplicate orgs split provenance; `rotate: true` aimed at the wrong org kills a prod key.

**State on** `develop` **today** (`platform.ts:495,537`): `externalRef` is trimmed and checked for presence and `≤128` chars only — no shape check, although §4 defines it as S's Org GUID. Nothing ties the provisioning credential to an environment, so a staging S holding a prod-shaped key is indistinguishable from prod S.

**Add to the done-when:**

* `externalRef` validated as a GUID (400 on anything else) — a typo cannot mint a second org.
* Environment-scoped provisioning credentials: a key minted for one environment is refused by another (env tag in the key record or prefix, checked at `register-connector`), so a staging S cannot register or rotate against prod K.

**Done when:** an anomalous rotation volume raises an alert, the route is rate-limited, and refused attempts are correlated well enough that a probing pattern is visible rather than scattered across logs.

*Split from* [KS-480](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-480) *per @kamil.kreiser's ruling 2026-08-07.* [KS-579](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-579)–[KS-582](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-582) *are @peter's own candidates carried over unchanged;* [KS-577](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-577) *and* [KS-578](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-578) *are additions from the 2026-08-06 verification. Findings checked against* `develop` `c8ce65dca`; Finding B confirmed live on the demo VM read-only.
